long_description:
Join us at Green Street in Downtown Lee’s Summit for a FREE, beginner-friendly Yoga 101 class designed for everyBODY.

Never tried yoga before? Perfect. This class is for YOU! No experience, flexibility, or fancy yoga clothes needed. Just come exactly as you are.

🧘 Last Sunday of every month

⏰ 9:30 – 10:15 A.M.

We’ll practice outside on the lawn when the weather is beautiful. If Mother Nature doesn’t cooperate, we’ll move inside the Green Street Market building.

What to bring:

💜 Yoga mat or towel

💜 Water bottle

💜 Comfy clothes

Come move your body, breathe, connect with your community, and experience what Megan’s Yoga Tribe is all about.

🎉 BONUS: Every attendee receives a FREE 7-day trial membership to Megan’s Yoga Tribe!

Free yoga + community + 7 days of MYT. What’s not to love?
